notes.title: Phone app 1.8 - pictures fixed
notes.text: Open the Restalker app and tap Allow on the yellow line at the top (only once). It then installs 1.8 by itself - and every update after it. (If you have not installed 1.7 yet: tap this message to download 1.8 instead.)

notes.title: Phone app 1.0.0 (beta) is on its way to your devices
notes.text: It installs itself on your phones and tablet (open the app to get it sooner). New: In stock now, the Bought groups and the Activity days fold; Bought sorts by All / Product / Store / Device; an amber BETA mark on your devices; the numbering starts again at 1.0.0 (it comes after 2.15). Everyone else keeps 2.14 until you run Release to everyone. Your note 6 arrived empty - send it again when you can.
